open_points.subject: public_op:bindings.propose_binding
open_points.text: The binding `proposed` with its identity, effect class, key fields and pinned `record_digest`.
open_points.question: Must a successful proposal be stored and returned with its input ports and output ports normalized into Unicode code-point name order, regardless of the order supplied by the caller?
options: Normalize each direction into port-name order before storing and returning the new binding.
Preserve the caller-supplied port order in the stored and returned binding.
open_points.default_guess: Normalize input and output ports separately into Unicode code-point name order before storing and returning the newly proposed binding.

witness.initial: A manifest operation is valid under every check of A08 rule 5, and its proposed input and output ports are supplied out of name order.
events: An agent calls the surface to propose the binding.
module:surface calls bindings.propose_binding with the ports in the supplied order.
module:bindings validates and records the proposal.
outcomes: The returned and stored binding has its input and output ports in name order.
The returned and stored binding preserves the caller's out-of-order port lists.
witness.observer: The proposing caller, and any later caller reading the binding.
